info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Pharmacy Prescriptions Interactions-v2-spec
info.description: The Pharmacy Prescriptions Interactions API provides a comprehensive overview of potential interactions associated with various pharmacy prescriptions. By querying this endpoint, users can access essential data regarding interactions between prescribed medications, which is crucial for healthcare providers and pharmacists. This API is designed to support applications aiming to enhance patient safety through informed prescription management. Typical consumers include healthcare professionals, pharmacy systems, and electronic health record platforms seeking to integrate drug interaction insights into their workflows.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to retrieve information about potential interactions between medications listed in their prescriptions. It helps in identifying any harmful combinations or side effects that may arise when taking different medications together.

requestBody.description: The request body for retrieving interactions related to prescriptions. This may include various parameters to filter or specify the interactions based on patient data or medication details.

200.description: Successful retrieval of prescription interaction data.
